methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen quad roller skates spanning entry-level kids' adjustables to industrial derby/jam setups, verified 2026-08-11 against manufacturer product pages (Moxi, Impala, Riedell, Sure-Grip, Chaya/Powerslide, Roller Derby/Candi Grl, VNLA via RollerSkateNation, Bont, Antik) and major specialty retailers (RollerSkateNation, USA Skates, Ice Warehouse, Derby Warehouse); three adversarial corrections were made to the seed list — the seed's "Candi Girl Sabina" is officially spelled "Candi Grl Sabina" (Roller Derby Skate Corp) and is used as sourced from rollerderby.com; "Rollerskatenation Rock GT-50" attributed the product to a retailer rather than its actual manufacturer, so brand was corrected to Sure-Grip (the GT-50 "Rock" plate skate is a Sure-Grip product sold across many retailers, sourced here directly from suregrip.com); and "Antik Skyline" does not exist in Antik's current or past lineup per Antik's own site and Derby Warehouse's full Antik catalog, so it was replaced with Antik's actual current outdoor recreational model, the Skyhawk Outdoor, as the closest real product a buyer would find under that brand. Prices are USD list/current-retail figures where available; Chaya's Melrose Deluxe and Bliss are sold in the US almost exclusively through Powerslide's EUR-denominated storefront with no confirmed USD MSRP from a US retailer found, so priceUsd is left null with the EUR figure recorded in priceNote rather than guessing an FX-converted number. weight_per_skate is null for every entry because no fetched manufacturer or retailer source published a per-skate weight figure (only full-package shipping weights, which were not used to avoid conflating packaging with product weight). accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.

products.name: Moxi Lolly Outdoor Complete Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current price on moxiskates.com (Floss colorway); Moxi's other Lolly colorways/trims list from $379.99 to $409.99 depending on wheel/plate package
products.provenance: Moxi's own product page confirms $399.00 price, high-top suede boot, Powerdyne Nylon Thrust plate, offset Powerdyne adjustable toe stop with stabilizing foot plate, ABEC-5 carbon steel bearings, and 65mm x 35mm wheels, but does not itself state a wheel durometer figure. The 78A durometer is corroborated via RollerSkateNation's listing for the same Sunlite-wheel Lolly line, which documents the black 65mm wheel option (matching this page's 65mm diameter) as 78A; Moxi's outdoor "Gummy" wheel compound is consistently marketed at 78A across the line, so this is treated as confirmed rather than a guess.

products.name: Moxi Beach Bunny Outdoor Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current retail at RollerSkateNation (Strawberry Lemonade colorway); Moxi's list price is $169.00, frequently discounted
products.provenance: RollerSkateNation's listing (an authorized Moxi dealer reproducing Moxi's own spec copy) documents 58mm/78A wheels, ABEC-5 bearings, a Marvel aluminum plate, drum-dyed vinyl upper with PVC outsole/heel, and an adjustable toe stop. Beach Bunny is Moxi's signature retro low-cut boot (as distinct from the Lolly's high-top), so boot_type is recorded as low-top. Moxi's own site could not be reached directly for this specific product page (404 on the guessed URL), so the retailer page — which reproduces the manufacturer's own listing copy — is used as the primary source.

products.name: Impala Quad Skate
products.priceNote: Current price on impalarollerskates.com (Black colorway); other colorways range $84-$119
products.provenance: Impala's official US product page confirms 58mm/82A wheels, ABEC-7 bearings, a lightweight aluminum-alloy truck/baseplate, matte black PVC upper with padded collar and tongue (Impala's signature low-cut retro boot), and a fully replaceable PU brake stopper rather than an adjustable toe stop. Price $107.00 as listed directly on impalarollerskates.com.

products.name: Riedell R3 Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current retail at Ice Warehouse (authorized Riedell dealer); Riedell's own JS-rendered product catalog did not return specs on direct fetch
products.provenance: Ice Warehouse's spec table (authorized Riedell dealer) lists the wheel size verbatim as "62x43mm" and hardness as "95A" — the 95A figure is unusually hard for a recreational skate and is recorded as directly quoted rather than corrected by analogy, since no conflicting figure was found; wheel_diameter_mm uses the 62mm leading figure, with 43mm read as wheel width. Vinyl boot with cloth lining and velcro/lace closure, PowerDyne Thrust nylon plate, ABEC-5 bearings, and an adjustable PowerDyne toe stop with nut & washer lock are also confirmed on this page. USA Skates independently corroborates the PowerDyne Thrust Nylon plate, ABEC-5 ("KwiK ABEC-5") bearings, Midi Gripper-style vinyl boot, and $199.99 price, but lists Radar Cayman wheels without a diameter/durometer figure.

products.name: Riedell Dart Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current retail at USA Skates, Inc. (authorized Riedell dealer)
products.provenance: USA Skates' listing (authorized Riedell dealer reproducing manufacturer spec copy) confirms 62mm/93A wheels, ABEC-5 bearings, PowerDyne Thrust Nylon plate, Midi Gripper toe stop, and $174.99 price. Derby Warehouse independently corroborates the PowerDyne Marvel cast-aluminum-plate detail for a higher-tier Dart variant, but the base Dart set (this entry) uses the nylon Thrust plate per USA Skates and Sucker Punch Skate Shop. Dart is Riedell's low-cut recreational/junior-derby boot, so boot_type is low-top.

products.name: Sure-Grip Boardwalk Plus Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current price on suregrip.com; item shown as sold out at time of access
products.provenance: Sure-Grip's official product page confirms 62mm/78A wheels, ABEC-7 bearings, a USA-made Rock Nylon plate, an all-suede high-top boot with stitched sole and padded liner, and a Carrera adjustable toe stop. Price $259.99 as listed directly on suregrip.com; the seed name "Sure-Grip Boardwalk" is sold today as "Boardwalk Plus" (the base non-Plus "Boardwalk" trim listing on suregrip.com resolves to a discontinued/renamed product page), so the current Boardwalk Plus is used as the real currently-sold product.

products.name: Sure-Grip Fame Roller Skate
products.provenance: Sure-Grip's official product page confirms 57mm Fame-branded wheels, ABEC-7 bearings, USA Rock nylon plates, a vegan boot with microfiber lining and roller collar (Sure-Grip's indoor high-top rhythm boot), and a 5/8in. adjustable Carrera rubber toe stop (mini bolt-on for junior sizes, Bullseye bolt-on for adult size 14). The page states wheel size but never states a durometer/hardness figure for the Fame-branded wheel, so wheel_durometer_a is left null rather than assumed from Sure-Grip's other outdoor lines.

products.name: Chaya Melrose Deluxe Roller Skate (Turquoise)
products.priceNote: EUR 139.99 (sale price) on powerslide.com, Chaya's parent-company storefront; no confirmed USD-denominated price from a US retailer was found, so left null rather than FX-converted
products.provenance: Powerslide's official Chaya product page confirms 62mm x 38mm / 80A Octo Paseo wheels, Wicked 608 ABEC-9 bearings, an AL 6063 aluminum plate at a 15-degree truck angle, a high-cut vegan textile-lined boot with standard lacing, and a Chaya Controller flat toe stop with 30mm stem. RollerSkatePro.com (US retailer) independently corroborates this exact spec set (Octo 78A wheels on some colorways, Wicked ABEC 7 on others, aluminum plate) across the six current Melrose Deluxe colorways; the Turquoise colorway's own spec sheet (Octo Paseo 80A / ABEC-9) is used as the single internally-consistent source rather than mixing figures across colorways.

products.name: Chaya Bliss Adjustable Roller Skate (Turquoise)
products.priceNote: EUR 89.99 on powerslide.com, Chaya's parent-company storefront; no confirmed USD-denominated price from a US retailer was found, so left null rather than FX-converted
products.provenance: Powerslide's official Chaya product page confirms 62mm/78A outdoor-cruising-comfort wheels, Wicked ABEC-5 carbon-steel bearings, a glass-fiber-reinforced-plastic (Chaya Aja composite) plate, a high-cut adjustable vegan boot spanning EU 31-42 via a sliding toe-cap mechanism, and an offset rounded toe stop with the Power Toe System. RollerSkatePro.com independently corroborates the Vanilla and Turquoise Bliss variants sharing 62mm/78A wheels and Wicked ABEC bearings (ABEC-5 or ABEC-7 depending on colorway); the Turquoise colorway's own ABEC-5 figure is used to stay internally consistent with the single sourced page.

products.name: Candi Grl Sabina Quad Roller Skate
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed brand "Candi Girl" is officially spelled "Candi Grl," a Roller Derby Skate Corp house brand; rollerderby.com's own product page (URL slug "cand-grl-sabina-quad-roller-skates") confirms this spelling and the model's existence, $79.99 price, a hightop freestyle vegan boot, indoor/outdoor polyurethane wheels, a lightweight high-impact chassis with PU cushions, and Bevo Silver-5 Race Rated chrome bearings. The page states wheel size inconsistently as both "56mm x 33mm" and "58x33mm" in different sections; 58mm is used as it matches the size commonly cited for this model elsewhere. The page does not state an ABEC rating (Bevo Silver-5 is the manufacturer's own bearing-line name, not an ABEC-graded spec) or a toe-stop type, so both are left null rather than assumed.

products.name: Sure-Grip GT-50 Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current price on suregrip.com (sale price); a "GT-50 Motion" outdoor-focused variant is also listed at the same $199.99 price
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed listed this product's brand as "Rollerskatenation," which is a specialty retailer, not the manufacturer; the GT-50 is a Sure-Grip product (a "Rock"-plate outdoor/rhythm skate) confirmed directly on suregrip.com — 62mm/95A wheels, ABEC-5 bearings, a USA-made Rock Nylon plate (50% recycled nylon), a vegan low-cut boot with padded interior/collar, and Carrera speed-style (fixed, non-adjustable) toe stops. Brand corrected to Sure-Grip; RollerSkateNation is retained only as the kind of retailer that sells this model, not as the source of record.

products.name: VNLA Jr. Lagoon Jam Skate
products.priceNote: $249.99-$255.99 at RollerSkateNation depending on size; VNLA does not sell direct to consumers on a US-facing storefront that could be reached, so a retailer listing is used

specs.toe_stop_type: jam plug standard; adjustable toe stop available for +$6.00

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed "VNLA Junior" is not itself a single model name; VNLA's junior/kids jam-skate line ships as several named colorways (Jr. Lagoon, Jr. SLVR, Jr. Stealth), all sharing identical specs and $249.99-$255.99 pricing per RollerSkateNation (an authorized VNLA dealer). The Jr. Lagoon colorway is used as the representative entry: 62mm/92A wheels, VNLA Reaction ABEC-9 bearings, a VNLA Gorilla nylon plate with aluminum trucks, a VNLA Lagoon leather low-cut jam boot, and jam plugs standard with an optional adjustable toe stop upcharge. VNLA's own storefront (thisisvnla.com and variants) could not be reached directly, so the authorized-dealer listing is used as the source of record.

products.name: Bont Prostar Tracer Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current sale price at Derby Warehouse (authorized Bont dealer), reduced from $339.00
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: bont.com no longer sells a single fixed "Prostar" complete skate — the current Prostar line is a build-your-own boot+plate system split into Tracer and Athena series. The Tracer Series complete package (Bont Hybrid microfiber/fiberglass boot on a Prostar 6061-aluminum plate) is used as the representative real, currently-sold product, sourced from Derby Warehouse (an authorized Bont dealer): 60mm x 40mm / 92A wheels, Bont Pro 608-format bearings (a fixed bearing size, not an ABEC-graded spec — left null rather than assumed), 6061 aircraft-aluminum plate, and an adjustable 5/8in. toe stop with clamp-lock. Bont's own site confirms the Prostar Tracer Series exists and lists boot-only pricing ($169.00) but does not publish a single fixed complete-skate price, so the Derby Warehouse package price is used.

products.name: Antik Skyhawk Outdoor Roller Skate
products.priceNote: Current price at Derby Warehouse (authorized Antik dealer); Antik sells through a dealer network rather than direct consumer MSRP

specs.toe_stop_type: adjustable (Powerdyne Round, 5/8 in., nut & washer lock)

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: no "Antik Skyline" model exists in Antik's current or archived lineup — checked against Antik's full product catalog on Derby Warehouse (Skyhawk Outdoor, Skyhawk Indoor, Skyhawk Park, AR2 Derby, AR2 Arius/Avenger bundles, Jet Carbon) and Riedell Skates' own Antik brand catalog page, neither of which lists a Skyline. The seed was replaced with the closest real current product a 2026 buyer would find under the Antik name for general/outdoor recreational use: the Skyhawk Outdoor, confirmed on Derby Warehouse at 62mm x 32mm / 85A wheels, ABEC-5 bearings, a Powerdyne Thrust nylon plate, a microfiber high-top boot with abrasion-resistant toe cap and shock-absorbing heel wedge, and an adjustable Powerdyne Round toe stop, for $249.00.
